tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dga' bde rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dga' bde rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyab bdag rigs kun 'khor los bsgyur/ /dpal ldan bde chen phyag 'tshal nas/ /drwa ba sdom pa las 'byung ba'i/ /rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs bshad/ /de ltar yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi rim pa yis/ /de yi lam la rab tu sbyor/ /zhes rnal 'byor bzhi ldan du bsgom par gsungs la/ bdag nyid che ba'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag la bdag gis rab tu mchod/ /ces gtso bo bskyed pa rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor thams cad bde ba yi/ /rjes su sbyor bas mchod byed cing*/ /zhes rig ma sgrub cing rjes chags brtsam pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ rgyud la myang bar byed pas ni/ /shin tu sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes mngal gnas nas/ dkyil 'khor spro ba shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /ra sā ya ṇa'i bde ba 'di/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dpal dang*/ /nad med lang tsho bde mchog 'grub/ /ces skye mched byin rlabs dbang bskur mchod bstod la sogs pa ni/ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /de la dang por 'di nyid kyi mchod chog gtor 'bul la sogs pa sngon du song na shin tu legs/ yang phyogs 'dir bar skabs su byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs tsam byed pa'ang mi 'gal zhing legs pa'i yan lag yin la/ sgrub thabs tsam nyams su len pa la de dag ma bsgrubs kyang 'gal ba med pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams bla med spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ nad mchod/ sum+bha 'am/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa nang 'od gsal chags thogs med pa la gnas pa'i dri chen dri chu rak+ta rkang dang byang sems te bdud rtsi lnga dang ba glang khyi rta glang po sha chen te sgron ma lnga/ hūṃ oṃ hriḥtraṃ haṃ/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas dang yi ge rnams zhu/ hūṃ oṃ hriḥhriḥhāṃ haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mraṃ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ zhes brjod/ rigs drug gi sa bon las phyag mtshan dang de las skur gyur pa'i 'phro 'dus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas rdo rje la bzhugs/ rdo rje dang zla ba snod du lhung ba las zhu ste 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dang dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i lag pa g.yas par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drug gi dbus su/ hūṃ oṃ haṃḥhrīḥtraṃ haṃ rnams las/ rdor sems rnam snang khrag 'thung dang*/ /gar dbang nyi ma rta mchog go /lag pa g.yon par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor drug gi steng du/ a yig dkar po drug las/ kun tu bzang mo sangs rgyas spyan/ /kro dhī shwa rī gos dkar mo/ /mā ma kī dang sgrol ma'o/ /lce la/ na mastū sarba bud+dhe bh+yaḥzhes pas mtshan pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ bdud rtsi myang*/ bdag nyid sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gyur/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mdzod spu nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis srid pa gsum po sbyangs/ rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ rang gi tshangs bug tu zhugs shing thim/ snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza hūṃ/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes spyan drangs/ mahā sa ma s+t+waṃ/ lan gnyis kyis chu gnyis phul/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ/ bgegs thams cad bshig cing bsrung ba'i 'khor los mtshams bcad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ na mo gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa me naṃ badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ oṃ a ti bhu ho/ / zhes phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pa/ /rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi d+ya trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā haṃ ra hīḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo a laṃ ka ra pa na bai hūṃ swā hā/ bodh+yaṃ rat+na me gha s+pha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ na maḥsarba pañtsa rā sa ya ṇa a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ nang mchod dang*/ oṃ bo d+dhi tsit+ti ma hā su kha hūṃ/ zhes gsang mchod phul/ 'grub na khyad par gyi bshags pa yang bya/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*/ /rnam kun btud de skyabs mchi zhing*/ /mchod 'os gzhan la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa las ni bzlog bgyi zhing*/ /bsod nams thams cad yongs su bzung*/ /lus can rnams kyi bsod nams dag /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bdag ni lus btud thal sbyar nas/ /gsang ba'i theg chen bshad pa dang*/ /'gro gnas bar du bzhugs slad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams gang*/ /bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis gang*/ /des ni sems can thams cad kyang*/ /bla med byang chub gnas thob shog

ces rgyun bshags bya/ 'di ni slob dpon ku ku rā dza'i cho ga lnga pa las 'byung ba yin/ gtam bya rin chen 'phreng ba'i tshig gi zur cung zad bsgyur bar snang la/ gsang don rnam par bkod pa dang*/ hūṃ mdzad grags pa'i yan lag bzhi pa las 'byung ba sogs ni/ ha cang mang grags pas ma bkod do/ / mthar/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ta dri dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaṃḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa badz+ri bha wa mahā sa ma yā sa twa āḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa'i mthe bong bsgrengs nas g.yob/ rdo rje thal mo'i rmad lan gsum brdab/ oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha mu/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de dag ni yul dman pa dang mchog la tshogs bsags pa'o/ / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re phye rol bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ de'i dbus su bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'o/ / dpung pa gnyis pa snol zhing se gol gtogs pa'i sgra dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas thams cad bka' bgrau+o ba mdzad de gcig tu 'dus pa/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' la thim pa hūṃ du gyur/ hūṃḥ ring po gsum sna bug nas brjod/ rang nyid khro bo thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po rab tu khros pa'i rtsa zhal mthing nag 'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer can g.yas dkar g.yon ser rgyab dmar ba ste zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭāṃ ga dril bu gsil pa dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/

gsum pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang thod pa/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs shing*/ yum chen kro dhi shwa ris 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs tshogs thams cad bkug ste/ hūṃ las byung ba'i khron pa rnams su bsgyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ in+d+ra ya dzaḥ ya ma ya dzaḥ wa ru ṇā ya dzaḥ ku bai ra ya dzaḥ ag+ṇa ye dzaḥ nai ri t+ya dzaḥ bhe ra ma hā ya dzaḥ ī shā na ya dzaḥ tsan+d+ra ya dzaḥ sur+ya ya dzaḥ su ra tā ya dzaḥ a ra pa ta ya dzaḥ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo bcu spros/ oṃ badz+ra krodha ya bi dza a hūṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha ya mān+ha ka hūṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha ha ya/ gṝ ba hūṃ h+ya hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ hūṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krodha a pa ra dzi ta hāṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūṃ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ gardzagardza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā ba la hūṃ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo thams cad sku mdog nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas rdo rje ral gri tho ba/ g.yon thod khrag zhags pa lcags kyu/ smad phur pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba tho ba bsnams pa sprul te/ khro bo rnams phyogs bcu'i bgegs la phur bu'i tshul du btab par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ta phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan kā ya wa kā tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/

lan gsum brjod/ 'od zer rnon po 'khrug cing 'bar bas kyang bgegs thams cad bsregs/ rdo rje gur gyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa grub ste/ khro bo bcu rnams de la bzhugs shing sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs kyis bgegs bsrung ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de dag ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i srung 'khor te sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams so/ / stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid stong gsum gyi yang thog tu gnas pas/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya mi maṇ+ḍal hūṃ bh+rūṃ/ skad cig tsam gyis e las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung dkar po kun tu bzang mo'o/ /de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rdo rje rgya gram dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa sgrol ma'o/ /de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba dkar po rtse mang pos mtshan pa gos dkar mo'o/ /de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa mā ma kī la'o/ / de'i steng du laṃ las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa spyan ma'o/ /der khaṃ las byung ba 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ suṃ/ las byung ba'i ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ rol mtsho ri dang bcas pas brgyan pa'o/ / de dag ni gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin no/ / de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma la gser gyi 'khor lo/ de'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i dbus su hūṃ las gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar mthing dmar ser ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa las/ rang byung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od zer 'phro pa'o/ /pha gu dang dra phyed dang shar bu dang mda' yab dang 'dod yon gyi snam bu la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/

rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'khyams kyi phyi rim la/ 'jig rten pa'i lha snam dkar pos bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol pad+ma dang 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba me dpung 'bar bas bskor ba/ phyi rol phyogs mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sa gzhi la dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba la/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sprin dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha za dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ grub pa thob pa dag gnas shing*/ ro dang*/ dum bu dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ keng rus dang*/ bya dang*/ gcan gzan sna tshogs pas khyab pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snam bu ser po/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje'i ra ba sngon pos bskor ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po de'i nang gi steng 'og rnams shar dkar lho sngo nub dmar byang ser dbus ljang khu'o/ /de'i dbus su nang gi gzhal yas khang rnams so/ / skabs 'dir dbus su gdung bzhi'i re mig dgu pa byas nas/ mtshams bzhi la rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lhag ma lnga dgod do/ /de shar du dkyil 'khor dgu byed pa ni rgyas pa yin la/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor gcig ni byas te/ dkyil du yang dag byed pa ni 'bring por 'gyur la/ lha dgu dgu'i nang gi dkyil 'khor kho na drug bkod nas mchod lha dang*/ bcas pa dkyil 'khor chen po kho na la bkod nas bsdus pa yin no/ dkyil 'khor dgu'am drug la bsrung 'khor tshun chod dang dur khrod dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs byed pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang rta babs dang bcas pa byed pa dang*/ rta babs med pa ste gsum po yang de dang de nyid la bltos pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mo/ /mchog gi 'khor gyi lha 'god tshul la/ dkyil 'khor dgu pa ltar na/

shar lho shar dang mtshungs pa sogs phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs par mi 'dra ba bzhi yin no/ /yang dkyil 'khor drug pa ltar gyis dbus dang phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor lnga dang*/ dbang ldan du rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor thob thang yin yang*/ bri cha la mi mdzes pas/ bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis shar gyi dkyil 'khor shar dbang ldan dang*/ lho'i dkyil 'khor lho me mtshams la nye ba dang*/ nub kyi dkyil 'khor nub bden bral la nye ba dang*/ byang gi dkyil 'khor yang rlung mtshams la nye ba'i nub dang*/ byang shar kyi dkyil 'khor dbang ldan la nye ba'i byang phyogs su 'god pa ste/ bde mchog 'khor lo bsgyur drug bzhin byed do/ / phyogs rnams su ji ltar 'god pa la/ kha cig shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma/ nub tu gar dbang*/ byang du rta mgrin 'god pa sogs 'dug kyang*/ yan lag bzhi pa las/ gnyis gong bzhin/ lhor he ru ka byang du nyi ma/ mtshams su rta rgyal/ dbus su rdor sems 'god pa nyid shin tu legs par mthong ste/ 'on kyang rang rang gi mos pa'i dbang dang*/ gang zhig gtso bor sgrub pa'i dbang las/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshul gyis 'god na ni/ rnam pa drug gar yang 'byung ste/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus bzhin no/ /spyi ldog nas rgyud 'di rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bor 'gyur pa yin pas/ he ru ka dkyil du bzhag

rdor sems mthar bton nas/ rigs bsdus la mnyam sbyor khro bo dang*/ rdor sems rigs rkyang la mnyam sbyor zhi ba'i tha snyad byed pa ni mi legs par mthong ngo*/ /des na re zhig la dkyil 'khor drug pa'i dbang du byas te brjod na/ dbus kyi gzhi ljang khu la/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa drug ste/ rtsig pa dang lha snam gyi phyogs mdog ni/ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga ni/ rdor sems khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor la'o/ /sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba shar/ /dkar ser nag ljang dmar ba nub/ /dkar nag dmar ljang ser ba dbus/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gzhi dkyil 'dra/ / yang lugs gcig ltar na dkyil 'khor phyi nang thams cad mtshungs par rtsig pa dang lha snam kyi phyogs mdog dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim par byas kyang rung ngo*/ / pho brang dbus ma rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su zlum po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ pho brang shar ma'i dbus su zlum po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ lho ma'i dbus su zla gam chen po kha dog dmar po sgo gcig shar du bstan pa/ thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor zhing*/ zhing gi 'phan gdugs sogs 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su zlum po re mig dgu pa la khro bo'i rdo rje 'phreng bas bskor ba/ dbus su pad+ma dregs byed nyi zla brtsigs pa'i gdan re mig brgyad la bam chen re re'o/ / dkyil 'khor nub ma'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs can/ ka ba dang mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /byang ma'i dbus su rin po che zur brgyad pa'i dbyibs can gyi dkyil 'khor la rin po che'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba'o/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rgya gram gyi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang sna tshogs rdo rje nyis rim lha'i gnas thams cad du pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad kyang nang le tshe dgu dgu dang ldan pa/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor ma gtogs dbus kyi le tshe la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan re re pad+ma thams cad kyi mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la/

rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thod pas kha brgyan pa re re dang*/ rta mchog la sna tshogs rdo rje nang ma'i mtshams bzhir bum pa dang bcas par gyur/ dkyil 'khor thams cad la mtshungs par sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir pad+ma'i gdan no/ /de dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor drug po thams cad gyi gtso bo'i gnas pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan rnams la/ rang gi sems nyid dpal mchog dang po bzhugs par mdzad de/ yod pa ma yin med pa min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs su med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa'o/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de'i tshe bde mchog ma la sogs pa bzhis/ rnam pa mang po'i 'dod chags rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ te na te te hūṃ/ rnam pa mang po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu sprul rol rnam par sprul/ /rnam pa mang po khro bo'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ rnam pa mang po srog gi rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ /hūṃ shiṣ+ya bi sha hūṃ/ zhes bskul bas stong pa'i ngang las/ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du ka kha ga gha nga*/

tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ྈྐ ྈྑ ྉྤ ྉྥ nga ro dang rnam bcad rnams las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed kyis mtshan pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las hūṃ du gyur/ de las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od dmar po 'phro ba'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od 'phros rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor sprul/ sems can thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pas shin tu 'od zer 'bar bar gyur pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /badz+ro3haṃ/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor drug kar gyi dbus su rdo rje sems dpa'i sku re re yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra sa twa a/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ gangs ri rdul bral me shel 'od/ /dkar mthing dmar dang ser pa'i zhal/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /kun tu bzang mo rang 'dras 'khyud/ /de ltar bdag nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin par gyur pa drug po rnams kyi sku la rigs drug gi lha'i rdul phra rab kyis khyab par gyur/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya rigs bdag bzhugs sa'i gnas lngar gdugs te/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje thal mo las mthe bong bsnol/ gung mdzub rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas pa/ mkha' dbyings dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgyas/ spyi mgrin snying lte yan lag thams cad la reg ste/ oṃ dharma dha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba nor bu'i rtse mo can phaṭa kyis mtshan pa'o/ /shes rab ma rnams kyi bha ga āḥlas pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa phyi rol chos 'byung gi dbyibs can/

ze 'bru la as mtshan pa'o/ /sa ma ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ zhes yab yum bcu gnyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen po'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes shing bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs/ slar 'dus te so so'i sku la thim/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab ma rnams kyi pad+mar spros/ yab yum bcu gnyis ka so so'i gnas su byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu bar gyur/ bde mchog ma la sogs pa rang rang gi lha mo bzhi bzhis so sor bskul ba ni/ stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor yod med mthus/ /nam mkha'i nyid du dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang dpal khyod bdag ces bskul bas/ byang chub sems kyi thig le drug po rnams/ hūṃ oṃ hīḥhrīḥhrāṃ haṃ rnams su gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te tshur 'dus thim pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams su bzhengs par gyur pa ni/ de yang dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i gtso bo'i gnas su hūṃ las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang dung dang kun da dang zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba la yid tsam dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum la rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bzhi rtsa zhal dkar ba g.yas sngo g.yon dmar rgyab ser ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dpyangs pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pas rab tu snyems pa dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ stod g.yogs dar dkar gser gyi ngang ris can dang smad g.yogs tshig gu'i na bza' gsol ba/

rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum kun tu bzang mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor shar ma'i dbus su/ khaṃ ngam oṃ las sangs rgyas rgyal ba rtag pa rnam par snang mdzad dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba g.yas ser g.yon dmar rgyab ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis stod g.yogs chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba'i grwa dang lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mkhar gsil dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pas rab tu 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lho ma'i dbus su hūṃ ngam hrīḥlas dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po rab tu khros pa'i rtsa zhal mthing nag 'bar ba chen po'i zer can/ g.yas dkar g.yon ser rgyab dmar ba ste zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dril bu dpyangs pa dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa rlung gis bskyod pa'i tshul can/ gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ snying chen pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs pa/ spyan gsum gdangs mig dmar po las me stag 'phro ba/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma ser nag gyen du 'khyil zhing*/ rdo rje'i ba spu g.yas su 'khyil ba/ zhal gdangs pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ rkan sgra gdab pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad bskum pa yum gyi brla la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa gshe ba 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba dang*/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa

nyid/ /gu lang dang*/ dbang chen dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pa dregs pa thams cad zhabs 'og tu gnon pa/ yum kro dhī shwa rī sngo skya thod khrag dang ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya can gyis yang dag par 'khyud pa'o/ /yang na he ru ka phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dung khragagayon gnyis bshor thod zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lha chen po'i g.yang gzhi stod g.yogs su bsnams pa'o/ /bsdu na he ru ka phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ser ral khar byas pa/ yum la yang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rgyab kyi phyogs su ser ral kha la brten pa khyad par gzhan rnams sngar dang mtshungs par bsgoms kyang rung ngo*/ /stod g.yogs gnyis dang smad g.yogs dang*/ /thod 'phreng gsum dang sbrul rgyan brgyad/ khrag zhag thal ba phyag rgya drug /de dag dpal gyi chas brgyad do/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i dbus su/ hrīḥlas pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal bco lnga nyams dang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ chags pa'i nyams ldan no/ /phyag g.yas lnga bcu'i rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dbyug pa ral gri la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon lnga bcu kha dog ma nges pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa/ zhabs nyi shu rtsa bzhi g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mtshan dpe rdzogs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /yang na zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyis pad sdong gnyis 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ zhabs rgyal po rol ba'i tshul du bsgoms na'ang legs so/ /dkyil 'khor byang ma'i dbus su traṃ las rdo rje nyi ma/ gser gyi mdog can zhal bzhi ser ba/ res 'ga' dmar zhing yid tsam khro ba/ phal cher lhag par 'dzum pas bzhad pa/ phyag dang po gnyis mda' dang gzhu/

'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri 'phyar zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan zhing sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin pas shin tu 'khyud pa'o/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ hūṃ ngam haṃ las rdo rje rta mchog rol ba'i sangs rgyas sku lus ljang khu/ rtsa zhal dmar ba g.yas sngo g.yon dkar/ steng zhal rta gdong ljang khu mgrin pa gtod de sgra 'byin pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang rgya gram dang ral gri dang mda' rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon bzhis sna tshogs pad+ma dang shaka ti dang be con dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang ba'i dang pos dus mtshan ma dang dpal mo/ gnyis pas zhi ba ma dang dga' ba ma/ g.yon bskum pa'i dang pos drag po dang khyab 'jug /gnyis pas 'dod lha dang tshangs pa mnan pa/ zhabs kyi mthil nas rdo rje'i rmig pa 'byin pas de rnams 'tshir bar mdzad pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ drag po chen po gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ gru mo phan chad kyi phyag rnams dmar zhing*/ pus mo man chad kyi zhabs rnams nag po/ rang 'od kyi yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang skya/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas nges par 'khyud pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bzhugs pa'o/ /yang na rta mchog ljang khu phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gsum pa dang*/ ral gri 'dzin par byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de ltar na 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa drug po thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' rnams dang*/ de rnams kyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ hūṃ oṃ hiḥhrīḥtrāṃ haṃ rnams su gyur/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs phaiṃ/

'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas khrus gsol zhing dbang bskur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ spyi bo nas zhugs te 'dres pas dam tshig pa rnams dang gnyis su med par thim/ dbang rtags su de bzhin gshegs pa lnga lngas dbu la brgyan/ mkha' dbyings dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgya rigs bdag gi gnas lngar gtugs la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ lan lnga/ sor mo thams cad nang du bsnol/ /rtse mo'i ngos rnams kun sprad la/ /mthe bos rdo rjes mnan pa ni/ /sna dang mig phugs lta bu ste/ /zhes pa'i thod skam gyi phyag rgya yang gnas lngar gtugs la/ hūṃ badz+ra abhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rin po che'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs la/ e rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur dpral mgrin sogs gnas lngar reg oṃ ṭ+rūṃ lan mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ pa ṭa laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes dar dpyangs bcing ngo*/ /skabs 'di dag tu/ gsang don rnam par bkod pa drug las/ rdo rje sems dpa' la rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba med de/ gnas lnga byin rlabs kyi rjes thogs nyid la dbang bskur sogs mdzad cing*/ rigs lhag ma lnga la de'i rjes thogs su/ skad cig tsam gyis 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bsgyur bar mdzad do/ /slob dpon hūṃ ka ras drug ka la rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbye ba dang zhu ba glus bskul mdzad do/ /de ni 'bras bur bzhengs lugs bla med spyi dang mthun pas shin tu legs par mngon la/ spyir yang rdor sems dang rigs gzhan lnga la rgyu 'bras rdor 'dzin byed mi byed kyi dbye ba yang med do/ /yang rgyud gcig gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa mnyam po la/ spyi ldog nas zhu ba glus bskul yod med gnyis ka 'byung ba 'khor lo sdom pa sogs dang 'dra bas/ rgyu rdor sems sngon du ma btang bar yang mngon byang lnga las he ru ka sogs skyed par rung ni rung ngo*/

rigs rkyang la de ltar yin pa bzhin du rigs bsdus la yang go bar bya'o/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ / rjes su chags pa rnam mang bde ba'i pad+mo rnams/ /dga' ba mchod pas gsal bar rjes su mchod byas pas/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i rnal 'byor bde bas bde sgrub mdzod/ /e ma ho mchog tu bde ba'i dam tshig ngo bo nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i rnal 'byor skal bzang mchog dgyes pa/ /rang gi dam tshig rtag la rol cig rol cig ho/ /zhes pa'i glus bskul/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi dbye bas/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas hūṃ oṃ hiḥhrī hrāṃ haṃ rnams las/ rdo rje 'bar ba= nas/ thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs par gyur/ rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rigs drug gi gsung gi yi ger gyur pa rnams so so'i ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'dus te byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig par gyur pa/ 'khor lo bzhi nas brgyud rang rang gi brta ka ste rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor phyin/ yang rjes chags kyi 'od zer kyis 'gro ba thams cad sbyangs/ rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pa shes rab ma drug po rnams kyi dbang gi gnas so sor gzhal yas khang so so lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ lha so so'i gnas su rang mdog dang mthun pa'i thig le re re/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi snying po'i yi ge ste sa bon rnams su gyur/ dbus kyi rnams gtso bo drug po rnams su gyur/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo drug po so so'i mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa āḥdza hūṃ baṃ ho su ra ta ghaṃ/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ oṃ he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hrīḥsarba duṣ+tan sa ma ya mu dra pra pañdza ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma nirte shwa ra hrīḥdza/

oṃ sid+dh+yaṃn+tuḥs ma yaḥsid+dh+ya mahā badz+ra rat+na ba ba ṭa ṭa traṃ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa khyad par can thams cad mdzad/ sems can thams cad rgyal ba rigs drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ so so re rer gcig tu 'dus nas/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi thugs kar thim/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyang rgyas par na/ rang sngags kyis 'byin pa yin yang*/ mdo tsam na sa bon gyis phyung bas chog ste/ dzaḥbade mchog ma dkar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa dang*/ hūṃ e ma ho bde ma gser mdog ling ga rdo rjes mtshan pa dang bha ga rin po ches mtshan pa 'dzin pa dang baṃ snang mdzad ma dmar mo sna tshogs rdo rje dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin zhing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gru mor brten pa dang*/ hoḥslob pa mo ljang khu g.yas mda' 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i tshul dang g.yon sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi la shar sogs g.yas skor gyis gnas pa'o/ /āṃ sangs rgyas byang chub ma dkar dmar tshangs pa'i mgo bos mtshan pa'i mda' bzhi dus gcig tu 'then pa'i tshul dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ bh+ruṃ chos kyi 'khor lo ma dkar ser g.yas pa'-i gung mo la 'khor lo dmar po dang sngon po gnyis bskor zhing g.yon dkur bsten pa/ haḥkhams gsum rnam rgyal ma dmar skya g.yas mdung rtse gsum 'phyar zhing g.yon rdo rje thugs kar bsten pa/ khaṃ 'dod pa'i dbang mo ljang khu dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma rlung gis bskyod pa 'dzin zhing gar mdzad pa rnams re mig brgyad kyi shar sogs phyogs bzhir g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ oṃ gling bu ma sngon mo/ haṃ/ pi wang ma ser mo/ waṃ/ rnga chen ma dmar mo/ saṃ/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu rnams re mig gi shar lho nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis 'khod/

oṃ me tog ma dmar ser/ āḥspos me ma dkar mo/ aṃ mar me ma dmar mo/ aḥ dri chab ma ljang khu rnams phyi'i mtshams kyi grwa bzhi la me nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ gling bu ma la sogs pa brgyad rang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ bde mchog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug po de rnams dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg mdzes chags pa'i nyams can/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba/ 'gying bag gi tshul dang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ / de dag ni rdor sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lha tshogs so/ dzaḥ rta mgrin 'phangs mtho ma dkar mo rta gdong can lcags kyu dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ hūṃ phag gdong ma sngon mo mche ba dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ baṃ/ snang ba ma dmar mo khyi gdong can nyi zlas mtshan pa'i lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ hoḥ thal bar 'jigs byed ro langs ma ljang khu ser ge'i gdong can dril bu dang*/ 'od dpag med pa'i skus mtshan pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa rnams gnyis gnyis spros te/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma dang phyi rol gzhi dkyil gyi shar sogs sgo bzhi la g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi phyag mtshan la rdo rjes mtshan pa ste gtum zhing khros la/ dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa g.yas pa brkyang zhing gnas pa me dpung 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de dag ni rdor sems dang gzhi dkyil gyi sgo ma rnams so/ / haṃ sangs rgyas kun brjod ma dkar mo ljags kyis mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/ hūṃ shin tu rgyal ma ser mo phyag gnyis thal mo rdeb pa/ trāṃ/ kun nas bzang mo dmar mo rdo rje rtse lnga dang rin po che'i za ma tog 'dzin pa/ dhaṃ/ mi zad pa'i snod ma sna tshogs mdog nor bus gang ba'i snod dang chos dung 'dzin pa rnams rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor gyi pad 'dab bzhi la 'khod/

oṃ sangs rgyas kun ldan ma dmar ser rgyal ba mi bskyod pa'i sku thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bruṃ/ zhal bzang ma dkar mo me long gi mdog can me long dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ ha/ sprin chen ma sngon mo ser ba 'bebs pa'i rdo rje'i sprin 'dzin pa/ khaṃ/ nam mkha'i spyan ma ser skya pad+ma mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ re mig brgyad kyi shar sogs phyogs bzhir g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ oṃ/ gling bu ma zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i bar mchod lha brgyad dang*/ sgo ma bzhi po sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa rnams spros te sgo bzhi la g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ ces 'don pa spo/ phyag mtshan la rdo rjes mtshan pa zhes pa'i gnas su/ 'khor los mtshan pa ste/ de dag ni rtag pa ste rnam snang gi lha tshogs so/ /hrīḥ go rī dkar ser cung zad zhi ba'i mdangs can zhal bzhi pa phyag brgyad kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pas tshangs pa'i mgo bzhi 'bigs pa/ h+ni/ tsau ri dmar ser drag mo'i nyams can g.yas gung mos 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gtod pa/ g.yon thugs kar lcags kyu 'dzin pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'khyud pa/ dz+dziḥ pra mo ha dmar nag rmongs byed kyi tshul can steng zhal phag gdong can phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo dang khu tshur bcings pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs/ dziḥ bai tā li dkar mo shi ba slong ba'i tshul can/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa rnams phyogs bzhi'i re mig la 'khod/ hūṃ/ puk+ka si sna tshogs pa'i mdog dang gar gyi stabs can/ rdo rje rtse lnga dang dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma 'dzin pa/ 'di'i sku mdog gi khyad par ni/ bol bzhi brla dpung dkar ba la/ lus sgrol nya bzhi dmar ba ste/ /phyag mchog lo ma sngon po 'dra/ / zhes gsungs shing*/ zhal ras sngon por don gyis thob brla ser skyar bshad pa yang yod do/ / phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍa li sngo nag dgugs skyod pa'i tshul can rlung ras rdo rjes mtshan pa dang tri shu la 'dzin pa/

hūṃ/ ghasma ri ser nag mi ro za ba'i tshul can ral gri dang me thab 'dzin pa/ phaṭa/ sme sha ma mthing nag rnam par g.yeng ba'i tshul can g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang dung dmar/ g.yon gnyis bshor thod dang zhags pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga se ral khar thogs pa rnams mtshams kyi re mig bzhi la 'khod/ de ltar khro mo brgyad po rnams ni/ zhing lpags dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ sbrul dang thod 'phreng dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad nyi ro'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /me mda' 'dzin ma dkar mo mda' gzhu thogs pa/ waṃ/ kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin ma ser mo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dril bur bcas pa thogs pa/ yaṃ/ 'khor lo 'dzin ma dmar ser 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dzin pa/ raṃ/ sna tshogs ba dan 'dzin pa ljang khu ba dan la dril bu dpyangs pa 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod/ me tog ma sogs lhag ma sngar dang 'dra ba las/ khro bo'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ phyag mtshan gyi skabs/ khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag ni he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams so/ /dzaḥ rnam gzigs ma dmar mo phyag g.yas pas pad+ma dmar po snyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ hūṃ/ sgrol ma ljang khu pad+ma sngon po'i sdong bu dkur bsten zhing g.yas pas de nyid 'dren pa/ baṃ/ sa 'dzin ma sngon mo 'khor lo dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ hoḥ khro gnyer ma dkar mo mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gar byed cing ut+pal mthing ga 'dzin pa rnams 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod/ hūṃ/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje gtod cing*/ g.yon pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ he/ sna tshogs pad+mo ma sngo ljang 'khor lo gyen du gtod pa dang sna tshogs pad+mo 'dzin pa/ āḥ pad+ma'i na bza' ma gser mdog chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang pad+ma ser po 'dzin pa/ hoḥ pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma dmar mo rdo rje rtse lnga dang pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ re mig brgyad kyi sogs 'gre/ gling bu ma sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/

chags pa'i nyams can pad+ma'i 'phreng bas klubs pa'o/ /de dag ni pad+ma gar dbang gi lha tshogs so/ /oṃ dbang bskur ma dmar mo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan 'dzin pa/ hrīḥ gter ldan ma ser mo rin po ches gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ hoḥ rgyal mtshan mchog ldan ma dkar dmar rgyal mtshan nor bu'i tog can 'dzin pa/ haṃ/ mchod chen ma ljang khu rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa rnams/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod/ dzaḥ mda' gzhu ma dmar ser mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ hūṃ/ ral gri sngon mo ral gri dang khra ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ baṃ/ nyi ma dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ hoḥ me 'bar ma ljang dmar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab 'dzin pa rnams re mig gi phyogs bzhir 'khod/ gling bu ma sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ phyag mtshan gyi skabs/ nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa sku la nor bu dmar po'i mdangs 'od 'phro ba'o/ /de dag ni rdo rje nyi ma'i lha tshogs so/ /rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor la ni/ dzīḥ rta mchog gi g.yas su lha mo sna tshogs pad+ma ma ljang ser/ haḥ rta mchog gi g.yon du lha mo sna tshogs rdo rje ma ljang khu/ gnyis ka'ang g.yas rang ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gcig pa'i skabs/ rigs bzhi ji ltar sbyar kyang rung ba las/ las dang rin chen phyogs mtshungs rgyud sde spyi lugs kyi phyir nges par rdo rje nyi ma dang mtshungs pa yin pas zhi dkyil du byed na de ltar bya la/ yang rnam snang dang mtshungs par 'dod pa'ang yod do/ khro dkyil du byed na he ru ka'i lugs bzhin no/ /de la rta mchog khro bo gtso che bas/ hrīḥ gau rī dkar ser zhes sogs la/ phyag rgya mdzad pa rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar la sogs pa'i dbus kyi rwa bzhi la 'khod/ ces pa dang*/ se ral khar thogs pa rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa bar/

mtshams bzhi la 'khod/ ces 'dod pa spo/ /maṃ mda' 'dzin ma nas 'dab ma bzhi la 'khod kyi bar mi dgos/ a me tog ma sogs/ gong du bshad pa ltar las/ lha mo thams cad kyi phyag mtshan la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de ltar ye shes kyi lha tshogs mngon du bzhengs pa na/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tshul du shar du lha chen brgyad dang phyogs skyong*/ lhor gshin rje dang ma mo'i tshogs/ nub tu pho nya dang klu chen brgyad/ byang du gnod sbyin brgyad dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ gzhan yang bka' sdod dam can srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po dkyil 'khor la mngon par dad pa mtha' yas pa'i tshogs rnams phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i snam bu la 'khod par gyur/ rigs bsdus kyi skabs 'dir lha mo thams cad rang snang gi yab dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i skabs kyang yod mod kyi/ mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ thams cad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rig mar byas na bsgom pa bde'o/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor drug ltar la 'khor gyi lha mo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma la sgo ba bzhi/ de steng gtso bo yab yum bcu gnyis te/ brgya dang so brgyad do/ /gtso bo yab yum gnyis med dang*/ rdor sems dkyil 'khor dang gzhi dkyil gyi sgo ba rnams rigs mthun sdom pas/ brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad du'ang bshad pa yin no/ /spyir dkyil 'khor dgu pa'i dbang du byas nas/ nyis brgya dang drug gam/ zhe gnyis sam/ drug cu'i bar gyi rnam gzhag kyang yod do/ /bla ma gong ma rnams dkyil 'khor drug tshoms la gtso bor mdzad pa rkyang par 'dug pa dang*/ cung zad bsdus pa nye bar 'kho ba'i phyir 'dir dkyus la drug pa'i dbang du byas te bshad pa yin no/ /'on kyang bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni dkyil 'khor dgu pa nyid bzang zhing*/ rta mchog la pad 'dab kyi lha mo rnams kyi dod sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje ma gnyis nyid yin pas/

dkyil 'khor so so'i 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams spangs pa nyid yin par nges so snyam mo/ /yang rdor sems dang rnam snang gi lha rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung*/ he ru ka'i rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs/ gar dbang gi rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung/ rta mchog gi rnams khro bo'i skyil krung ste/ brkyang bskum mo zhes kyang 'ga' zhig las 'byung ngo*/ /de dag ni shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ / dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mig dang gzugs phung la rnam par snang mdzad/ rna ba dang tshor ba la rdo rje nyi ma/ lcai dang 'du shes la pad+ma gar dbang*/ sna dang 'du byed la rta mchog yid dang rnam shes la he ru ka lus dang ye shes la rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ dhū pe dhu/ ā lo ki hri/ gan+dhe gaṃ sarba pū dza s+pha ra ṇa hūṃ/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis bdud rtsi'i bum pas khrus byas shing gnas gsum du dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dang bral bar byas/ lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ pa ṭa laṃ ba hūṃ/ oṃ baṃ badz+ra ruṣ+tu heḥ khaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/

zhes rnam snang gi lha tshogs dang*/ hi a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ he ru ka'i dang / hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dang*/ trāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes rdo rje nyi ma'i dang*/ haṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes rdo rje rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ro/ /rnal 'byor gyi yan lag la/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ bzlas pa/ thig le phra mo ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ a ti bhu ho/ ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ gu ru pa ti a la la ho/ zhes phyag bya/ oṃ 'byung ba chen po thams cad 'byung*/ stong gsum rdul snyed ma lus pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus spro/ /me tog bdug pa mar me ma/ /dri mchog kun gyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ pa na po nu pur ra ti pu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma yo gi sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes mchod pa sprul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhu pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ pra tits+tsha ho/ shrī bhaṃ ga wān/ kha kha khā hi/ zhes phul/ gzhan yang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs/ shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar ro/ /de nas hūṃ zhes skad gsangs mthon pos glur blang ste/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i glu'i phyag rgya bcings/ 'di la chos kyi snying po'i gsal kha gzhung rnams na med/ kun tu bzang mo la sngags logs pa'ang med mod/ yab yum gnyis su med pa nyid kyi phyir gtso bo'i snying po brjod do/ / rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen skal bzang dpal khyod bdag cag bsgrubs la rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ kyai/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag nyid bde ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i tshogs rnams bde ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i rgyud rnams rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul mchog grub pa bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /a la la ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa sna tshogs gar rnams bstan du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ kyai ma bde mchog bde bas bzung la rnam par sprul hūṃ snang bar mdzad du gsol/ /a la la la la ho/

de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu mas slob ma bzung du gsol/ /rab tu dga' ba rjes su chags pa'i mda' gzhu rab tu phra bas rgyas btab pa'i/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sbyor ba'i bde bas myos pa'i bde bas thams cad bdag la grub par mdzod/ /rab tu bde mchog rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i longs spyod dang*/ /rab tu dga' ba'i dbang phyug che mchog grub pa de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu sna tshogs bde mchog rol cig hoḥ zhes pa ni dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i glu'o// rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu'i phyag rgya bcings la/ auṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṣa sid+dhi lo tsa ne/ sarba arba sid+dha ni swā hā/ zhes chos kyi snying po lha mo rnams kyi lce la bkod de/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad grub par mdzod/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol du gsol/ / rtag pa'i glu'o/ /dpal he ru ka'i glu'i phyag rgya dang*/ subha gasta ma hā na de bo/ ha ri mi ri/ shri ye/ zhes bkod la/ hūṃ rdo rje las kyi mda' gzhu la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje chags pa'i dam tshig dpal khyod 'dud/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rab tu 'jigs la 'dud/ /rdo rje dril bu rab tu 'khrol ba'i dpal/ /gzigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i rgyas thob la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'o byed 'khyud pas rmongs mdzad de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde ba'i mchog brtan kun stsol ma/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bde mchog ngo mtshar brtan du gsol/ he ru ka'i glu'o/ /gar dbang gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bkod la/ la lar rab tu drag cing skye bo dag la drag pa'i bud med sku ltar snang*/

/'gro ba mtha' dag 'dul phyir la lar rab tu snang ba'i 'khor lo phyag na bsnams pa'i sku/ /la lar nges shing zhi bar mi 'gyur sbyin pa tshangs pa'i skur yang ston par mdzad/ /la lar rab tu 'bar ba'i chags pa pad+mo'i dam tshig bdag la grub par mdzod/ / gar gyi dbang phyug gi glu'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i phyag rgya dang*/ traṃ ba ba ṭa ṭa ṭa tra ṭa/ zhes bkod la/ thams cad dbang bskur dbang phyug dam pa mi zad pa yi gter mchog bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sku mchog rgyal mtshan rgyal ba bsgreng rdo rje/ /rin chen shin tu che ba bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i glu'o/ /rta'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*/ hriḥpad+ma ba ṭa su kha yo gī shwa ra/ hi hi hi hi hi/ zhes bkod la/ la lar mkhas pa'i gzugs kyang 'dzin/ /la lar dus mtha'i dus ltar drag /la lar rgyal ba'i dbang bzhin zhi/ /la lar rta mchog sbyor bas 'grub/ /myos byed spyad las lhag par bde ba 'dod pa'i gzugs ston pa/ 'dul ba'i dbang gis gshin rje stong las lhag par rab tu 'jigs/ zhi ba'i sku ni tshangs pa stong las lhag par rab tu mdzes/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi mchog 'gyur de bzhin gshegs kun grub par mdzod/ / ces pa ni rta mchog gi glu'o/ /'dzub mo skyil krung du bsnol mthe bos bkab ste mdzub mo'i rtse mig 'bras ltar ston pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i glu'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo khong stong mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug ste mthe bo'i rtse dang sbyar ba ni rtag pa'i'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du 'phye mdzub mo bkug mthe bong mche ba ltar phyir brkyang ba ni he ru ka'i'o/ /rdo rje thal mo las gung mo rtse sbyar/ mthe bong mthe chung 'dab ma bzhir byas pa ni pad+ma gar dbang gi'o/ /rdo rje thal mo las mdzub mo phyir bkug ste de'i rtse mo mthe bos mnan pa ni rdo rje nyi ma'i'o/ /rdo rje thal mo las mthe chung srin lag mnyam par brkyang mdzum mo bkug ste rtse sprad pa ni rta'i rgyal po'i'o/

/ oṃ 'byung ba thams cad lnga las byung*/ /rang las ma byung gang yang med/ /gtsang sme'i dri rtog kun bral ba'i/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems chen po/ /bdag sogs gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa chen po'i gnas la rol/ /oṃ na maḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ swā hā/ byin rlabs mtshan dang rgyan ldan pa'i/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rol/ /oṃ mahā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta a la la ho/ / gnyis pa ni/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /des ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*/ /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*/ /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*/ khams gsum dag la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*/

/gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ /bcad gtubs la sogs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ /grib mas phog pa'-i sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad pa/ /sku yi phyogs tsam mthong ba'i mod la 'tsho ba dang*/ /gzigs mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi /'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams kun snang ba dang*/ /lus dang sems dang tshe ni rdo rje rab brtan te/ /re smon thams cad dus 'dir 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ / gsum pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ma hā sa ma ya āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i 'byin sngags drug po rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla la/ bzlas pa'i man ngag ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ steng 'og gi sna rtse la bslab pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs dang phal cher 'dra la/ lnga pa snying gar dbyangs gsal bcu drug po tshan gsum bskor ba'i dbus su/ a yig zla phyed thig ler ldan pa'am/ phyag mtshan bsgom par bshad la/ mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad mnyam nyid bde ba chen po bzung 'dzin dang bral ba la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi rjes la dag pa dran pa ni/ rten ni dge ba bcu yin te/ /gru bzhi bden pa bzhi ru brjod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rdo rje'i rwa/ /yon tan sna tshogs kun rgyas shing*/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi khyab mdzad zur/ /chos rdzogs sum cu rtsa bdun las/ /ting 'dzin bzhi po 'jug pa'i sgo/ /rang bzhin ye shes drug dag las/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs rnams/ /rnam thar brgyad po ka bar bcas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i tshul nyid mdzes/ /mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor chen por brjod/ /thugs rje chen po'i char phab bo/ /nyon mongs drug rnams rnam dag pa/ /de las ye shes drug 'dzin pa/ /rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gcig pu'i ngang*/ /rtog pas ma gos thugs rje'i bdag

/zla 'dra dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams dgod bya ba/ /nyon mongs nyi shu dag par mdzad/ / ces pa'o/ /rjes thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnam grangs du ma yod kyang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga kun la nye bar mkho ba yin la/ de la yang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba du ma snang zhing*/ skabs 'dir gtor chog rgyas pa ni/ ha cang ma nges par 'gyur bas/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bshad par bya'o/ /de la gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa 'dus byas/ maṇ+ḍal/ zla gam dmar po dbus su thig le lnga dang bcas pa bshams/ mchod rdzas rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ mahā tsakra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ hūṃ oṃ hiḥhrīḥtrī haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dpa' bo 'bru dgu dang*/ oṃ mahā kro tī shwa ri/ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ya āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'am 'bru gsum gyis kha gso/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su rdo rje rta mchog haṃ las 'khrungs pa/ de'i mdun du lha chen po g.yas su tshangs pa/ rgyab tu brgya byin/ g.yon tu khyab 'jug /de'i phyi rol shar phyogs su phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong*/ lho phyogs su ma mo'i tshogs/ nub phyogs su lha chen po rnams dang klu chen brgyad/ byang du 'byung po sna tshogs pa dang 'gro ba rigs drug gi gtso bo 'khor bcas gnas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor mgron gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ṭā ki nī bh+yo/ e a ral+li hring hring dza dza/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya phaṭa/ ces dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan/ oṃ i dam dhū pa/ puṣ+pa/ dī pa/ gan+dhe pū dza s+pha ra ṇa ar+ghaṃ ba ling kha kha/ zhes mchod/ gong du nang mchod byin rlabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa las/

oṃ āḥhūṃ te dzo ba ling ta ba la ba te/ gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūṃ hri tha/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi sngags kyi mthar/ i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags nas 'jig rten 'das pa la phul/ de dang spel nas/ oṃ 'jig rten kun gtso mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs byed drag byed stobs ldan pa/ /bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ldan snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang*/ /brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas/ /lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang*/ /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo gsus 'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs bcas dang*/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ /'gro ba drug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs sogs sbyangs byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyan dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can/ /las la brtson pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /las mdzad rdo rje bran bcas pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las sgrub cing*/ /theg chen gsang sngags srung ba dang*/ /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dbang bkra shis spel ba dang*/ /bde legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ pad+ma ba ḍa ba mu kha hūṃ hri/ oṃ hri badz+ra ḍā ki ni naṃ/ ba ling ta pra tits+tsha hūṃ khā hi/ oṃ āḥhri khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis mgron spyi la phul nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ thugs rje chen pos gzigs nas kyang*/ /sna tshogs rgyud rnams sprul mdzad pa'i/ /gar mkhan 'khor lo'i rgyud mnga' ba/ /drag po zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs gar gyi rnam par sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rdo rje la sogs mtshon chas rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus lha yi lha mchog skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo rtsal rdzogs stobs bcu'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti bhu ho/ a la la la la ho/ yig brgya lan gsum/ oṃ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas par/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub pa/ /ji ltar thugs kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /de nyid spyod par bdag gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /gats+tsha mu/ zhes ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag la thim/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'am/ nyal ba na/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de yang hūṃ la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du thim/

nyal ba las langs pa'am/ spyod lam la 'jug na/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas bzhir/ kaṃ haṃ aṃ tuṃ/ zhes go cha dgod/ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ phaṭa a ba lam+pa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar mos/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /'di'i sngags 'phreng rgyas pa bzla bar mos na/ gtso bo drug smos zin/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni/ dzaḥbadz+ra driṣ+ti sa ma ke ma ṭa/ hūṃ badz+ra ke lī kā+e lī hūṃ/ baṃ badz+ri ṇi sa ma ra na ṭa/ ho badz+ra kā me shwa ri traṃ/ oṃ aṃ ma du badz+ri gh+ruṃ gh+ruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra me ghe gu lu gu lu bruṃ/ oṃ haḥsha rang badz+ri aṃ aṃ/ oṃ khaṃ badz+ra she shi ri hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ aṃ ra ti badz+ra bi lā si ni tra ṭa/ he ra te badz+ra gī te te te te/ ho ra ti badz+ra ha s+ya ha ha baṃ/ oṃ he ra ti badz+ra nṛ t+ya be sa badz+raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ ā badz+ra dhu pe/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke aḥbadz+ra gan+dhe/ oṃ badz+raṃ ku shi dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā she hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shriṃ kha le paṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams so/ / oṃ badz+ra satwa shaṃ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma saṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma thaṃ/ haṃ satwa ba dz+re/ dz+raṃ badz+ra ra hre sa ta/ traṃ badz+ra pad+me dhaṃ/ bi shwa badz+ri/ lhag ma/ oṃ aṃ ra ti badz+ra sogs la/ badz+ra gyi dod du tsakra sbyar ro/ / rnam snang gi lha tshogs so/ /hūṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sid+dhi pa ra ma yo gī shwi ri hrīḥ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ri kha ṭ+wāṃ gi mahā badz+ra ka pā la mā lā ma ku ṭa ru lu ru lu hā/ hūṃ badz+ra nā rā yo ni dz+dziḥ hūṃ badz+ra pa twa re dziḥ hūṃ badz+ra pra ha ra maṭa/ hūṃ badz+ra shu la gri bhin+da maṭa/ hūṃ badz+ra ko she tshin+dha maṭa/ hūṃ badz+ra bi ma la pā she maṭa/ he badz+ra ra ti maṃ/ baṃ mahā rata badz+ri hoḥ oṃ badz+ra lo tsa ne yaṃ/ raṃ mahā shrī badz+re hīḥ a badz+ra puṣ+pe/ sogs brgyad ni rdo rje sems dpa'i skabs bzhin no/

/he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams so/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+mā dz+dzaḥ hūṃ badz+ra pad+mi he pad+mi pad+mi baṃ/ hoḥpad+ma ma ṇi rā dzi/ hūṃ pad+ma ṇ+ḍe shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ he mahā bi shwa pad+ma mūrte sid+dh+yaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hrīḥpad+mi pad+ma hūṃ āṃ/ hoḥpad+mi bi shwa kra mā kra mā hāṃ dz+dzaḥ zhes so/ / he ra ti pad+mi bi la si ni traṭa/ he ra ti pad+ma gi te te te/ he ra ti pad+ma hā s+ya hā sa baṃ/ he ra ti pad+ma nṛ t+ya bi pa ba dzaṃ/ lhag ma brgyad ni sngar dang mtshungs pa las/ badz+ra gyi gnas su pad+ma'o/ /pad+ma gar dbang gi lha tshogs so/ / badz+ra satwa dzaḥ badz+ra rat+na hūṃ/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma baṃ/ badz+ra kar+m+ma hoḥ oṃ pra ti badz+ri ni phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ri prī ti hrīḥ oṃ dziṃ ra mi ni hoḥ oṃ mahā ma ho hāṃ/ lhag ma bcu gnyis ni rdo rje sems dpa'i skabs bzhin las/ badz+ra gyi gnas su rat+na sbyar ba'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i lha tshogs so/ oṃ bi shā badz+ra dhar+m+ma dz+ri/ oṃ bi shwa badz+ra satwa haḥ lhag ma gzhan dang mtshungs te/ rta mchog gi lha tshogs so/ /lugs 'di'i gtor chog rgyas pa ni/ yan lag bzhi pa'i gzhung dang bla ma gong ma'i yi ge rnams las shes par bya zhing*/ mchod pa'i spros pa rgyas pa rnams kyang gzhung dag las shes par bya'o/ /yang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu 'gyur na ni/ gtor chog rgyas pa sogs su 'bri bar yang spro'o/ /rim pa 'di nyid kyi rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor rigs rkyang gi sgrub thabs rnams kyang rtogs par 'gyur la/ ci ste zhu ba glus bskul dang*/ rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbye ba mi byed pa'i lugs la mos na/ dpal mchog dang po'i sems nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dod yin la/ mngon byang lnga las 'bras bu'i lha so so bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs bsdus kyi skabs 'dir/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dbus su gang bkod pa gtso bo des/ dkyil 'khor mtha' dag spro bar byas kyang rung ba yin mod rigs rkyang so so'i cho ga zhor la shes par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pas dkyus nyid legs so/
